Annotated.Backend.message: provider API error: Jev HTTP 500 (some_error): the provider said no
Annotated.Backend.suggested_action: Jev failed on its side. Wait and retry; if it keeps failing, check the provider's status page.

ApiError.404.message: provider API error: Jev HTTP 404 (some_error): the provider said no
ApiError.404.suggested_action: Jev answered with an unexpected status. Check the endpoint and the request; retrying unchanged is unlikely to help.

ApiError.500.message: provider API error: Jev HTTP 500 (some_error): the provider said no
ApiError.500.suggested_action: Jev failed on its side. Wait and retry; if it keeps failing, check the provider's status page.

ApiError.503.message: provider API error: Jev HTTP 503 (some_error): the provider said no
ApiError.503.suggested_action: Jev failed on its side. Wait and retry; if it keeps failing, check the provider's status page.

ApiRequestInvalid.message: provider rejected the request: Jev HTTP 422 (some_error): the provider said no
ApiRequestInvalid.suggested_action: Correct questions as the provider's message says. Retrying the same request fails again.

AuthFailed.message: provider rejected the credential: Jev HTTP 401 (some_error): the provider said no
AuthFailed.suggested_action: Check that the Jev credential is valid, not revoked, and allowed to use this model; replace it in the process environment, the repo-root .env file or the keyring. Retrying with the same credential fails again.

ConfigInvalid.suggested_action: Fix the check.toml field or packaged jev.toml entry named in the message, then retry.

ConfigInvalid.Recovery.message: config is invalid: no git toplevel was found

CredentialStoreInvalid.message: credential store is invalid: the Jev API key (cause: key contains whitespace)
CredentialStoreInvalid.suggested_action: Store the key again without spaces.

EncodeFailed.message: response JSON could not be encoded as JSON (unexpected end of input error at line 1 column 1)
EncodeFailed.suggested_action: Retry; if it persists, report it as a bug.

ExtractionEmpty.suggested_action: Change the query or input so extraction emits at least one subject.

ExtractionFailed.suggested_action: Fix the producer failure named in the message and run extraction again.

ExtractionInvalid.suggested_action: Emit a valid sc/subjects/1 document on stdout and retry.

ExtractionParseError.suggested_action: Fix the syntax error at a.py:3 and run extraction again.

ExtractionTimeout.suggested_action: Raise timeout_seconds above 30 or reduce the input so extraction finishes in time.

GitTimeout.suggested_action: Check for a stalled git process, a lock file (such as .git/index.lock) or a slow filesystem; the same call times out again after 60s until that is fixed.

InputEmpty.suggested_action: Provide a non-empty input and retry.

InputInvalid.suggested_action: Correct the input so it matches the expected schema, then retry.

InputInvalid.Field.message: input is invalid: unknown backend nope
InputInvalid.Field.suggested_action: Correct --backend as the message says (see --help), then retry.

InputMissing.suggested_action: Create gone.toml or correct the path, then retry.

InputTooLarge.Bytes.message: input is 11 bytes; limit is 10 bytes
InputTooLarge.Bytes.suggested_action: Shrink the check input from 11 bytes to at most 10 bytes. One check is one request and is never split.

InputTooLarge.Provider.message: input exceeds the provider's tokens limit (Jev HTTP 400 (some_error): the provider said no)
InputTooLarge.Provider.suggested_action: Shorten the check input; the provider refused it as over its tokens limit. One check is one request and is never split.

InputTooLarge.Tokens.message: input is 40000 tokens; limit is 32000 tokens
InputTooLarge.Tokens.suggested_action: Shrink the check input from 40000 tokens to at most 32000 tokens. One check is one request and is never split.

IoFailed.suggested_action: Check that stdout exists and is readable or writable, then retry.

IoFailed.Interrupted.suggested_action: Check that stdin exists and is readable or writable, then retry.

IoFailed.TimedOut.suggested_action: Check that git output exists and is readable or writable, then retry.

KeyMissing.message: API key for typesafe is missing
KeyMissing.suggested_action: Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the process environment or in the .env file at the repo root (or store it in the platform keyring under the service name TYPESAFE_API_KEY), then retry.

LanguageUnavailable.message: language cobol is unavailable in sc-treesitter
LanguageUnavailable.suggested_action: Use a language built into sc-treesitter instead of cobol.

LogFlushFailed.suggested_action: Provide a non-empty input and retry.

NetworkError.Cancelled.suggested_action: The request was cancelled. Run it again if you still need the result.

NetworkError.Connect.suggested_action: Check connectivity and DNS to the provider, then retry.

NetworkError.Other.suggested_action: The transport failed in a way sc-agent could not classify, so it is not assumed to be transient. Check the endpoint, proxy and network; if it keeps happening, report it with the detail above.

NetworkError.Timeout.suggested_action: The request timed out. Retry later; a busy or slow provider may need a minute.

NetworkError.Tls.suggested_action: Fix the TLS setup (system clock, certificates, proxy) before retrying; retrying alone will fail again.

ProducerError.message: sc-treesitter failed with QUERY_NOT_FOUND: Use branches.

PromptFileMissing.suggested_action: Provide the LLM system prompt at prompt.md, or select it with check.toml or the CLI override.

ProviderBusy.Budget.message: provider is busy: Jev HTTP 529 busy after 3 sends; retry budget exhausted
ProviderBusy.Budget.suggested_action: Wait a minute, then retry; the retry budget ran out while the provider stayed busy. Another backend may have room.

ProviderBusy.Sends.message: provider is busy: Jev HTTP 429 busy; 4 sends exhausted
ProviderBusy.Sends.suggested_action: Wait at least 7 seconds, then retry; every allowed send was refused as busy. Another backend may have room.

QueryInvalid.suggested_action: Fix the tree-sitter query syntax named in the message and retry.

QueryNotFound.suggested_action: Choose a query asset that exists for this language instead of missing.

QuotaExhausted.message: provider quota is exhausted: Jev HTTP 429 (some_error): the provider said no
QuotaExhausted.suggested_action: Jev reports no tokens, credit or spend allowance left. Add credit, raise the limit, or wait for it to renew; retrying now fails again. Use another backend meanwhile.

RegistryInvalid.message: backend registry is invalid: Backend jev is not registered

ResponseInvalid.NotJson.suggested_action: The reply was not valid JSON. Check the endpoint and any proxy that rewrites responses; if the provider's own reply is fine, report the model's answer as a backend failure. Retrying the same request is unlikely to help.

ResponseInvalid.Schema.suggested_action: The provider's answers do not fit the questions. Retrying is unlikely to help; report it as a backend failure with the detail above.

ResponseInvalid.TooLarge.message: response is invalid (too_large): over the cap
ResponseInvalid.TooLarge.suggested_action: The reply was larger than the read cap. Retrying gives the same reply; report it, and check whether a proxy rewrites responses.

ResponseInvalid.Truncated.suggested_action: The provider stopped at its output limit. Ask fewer questions per check or shorten the state, then run it again; retrying the same check gives the same cut-off.

SessionDocumentInvalid.message: session document is invalid: Session file s is not a session document
SessionDocumentInvalid.suggested_action: Delete it and start a new session.

SessionExpired.suggested_action: Start a new session. Session 00000000000000000000000000 expired; expiry is measured from the session created_at timestamp.

SessionNotFound.suggested_action: Create a session or pass the id of a session that still exists. Missing session: 00000000000000000000000000.
